gloss: calm face; nonchalant look; acting as if nothing happened

definitions.gloss: calm face; nonchalant look; acting as if nothing happened
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who appears completely unaffected or unconcerned in a situation where others would be nervous, embarrassed, or troubled. Often implies the person is deliberately hiding their true feelings or pretending innocence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He had a nonchalant look on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}した→遅刻する：22282_chikokusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: Despite being late, he walked in looking completely unfazed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいにした。
examples.english: Even though it was his own mistake, he put on an innocent face and blamed someone else.

notes:
A figurative expression where ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧ (cool) describes not temperature but composure. The "cool face" is one that shows no embarrassment, guilt, or worry. Often carries a slightly negative nuance — the speaker is implying the person should be more affected than they appear.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on a nonchalant face
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}で〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something with a calm/unbothered expression
- {涼|すず}しい{顔|かお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{知|し}らん→知る：00458_shiru⟧ぷり: to pretend not to know with an innocent face

USAGE:
Can be used admiringly (staying cool under pressure) but more often implies criticism — the person is being too calm given the circumstances, or is deliberately feigning innocence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{知|し}らん→知る：00458_shiru⟧ぷり: pretending not to know — focuses on feigning ignorance
- ⟦{平然|へいぜん}→平然：21263_heizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: calmly, composedly — more neutral, without the visual image of a face
- ⟦{涼|すず}しい→涼しい：00674_suzushii⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: cool eyes — a related expression focusing on a detached, unimpressed gaze
